column1: # platforms.tsv -- every self-test entry point under fastest/linux, with the platform it runs on (lead order 2026-10-15,
# Ryan's class rule: the class "a gate script or test silently inherits the host platform or layout"). One row per
# entry point: path (relative to fastest/linux)<TAB>arguments<TAB>platform<TAB>why. run_everywhere.py runs every row
# from the row's own directory and refuses an entry point that has no row (an allowlist: a new test must state its
#   any    must pass on every platform it is run on (macOS and Linux today); a case inside it that needs Linux says so
#          itself and reports N/A-on-<platform> off Linux, never a pass
#   linux  the whole file needs Linux (the why says what); off Linux it is reported N/A, never a pass
# Every .sh row, and every `bash` its children run, is hostbin.py's bash 4+, never the caller's PATH's first bash.
